k:油.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of liquid that refuses to mix with water. Wherefore (由) does it float on top in shiny rings? Because it is fat. Oil (fat).

k:併.mnemonic: The leader (亻) lines up twenty (廾) people in a row (並) and has them link arms until they are a single chain. Join (get together, unite, collective).

k:牙.mnemonic: A long curved tooth jutting out past the jaw and ending in a hook, with the gum line drawn across the top. Tusk (fang).

k:概.mnemonic: With the point of a tusk (牙) the hunter scratches the rough shape of a root (根) in the dirt: no detail, only the general idea. Outline (condition, approximation, generally).
k:概.hint: Rough shape scratched in the dirt.

k:券.mnemonic: At the gate of heaven (天) stands a guard with a sword (刀), and no person (人) gets through without a slip of paper for him to tear. Ticket.
k:券.hint: Paper slip torn at heaven's gate.

k:副.mnemonic: The headman owns the rice field (田) and does the talking with his mouth (口). The man beside him carries the knife (刂) and steps in whenever he is away. Vice- (assistant, aide, duplicate).

k:如.mnemonic: A woman (女) opens her mouth (口) and out comes her mother's voice, word for word. The two are just alike. Likeness (like, such as, as if).
k:如.hint: She sounds just like her mother.

k:姉.mnemonic: The woman (女) of the family who left for the city (市) first, and who sends advice home to the younger ones. Elder sister.
k:姉.hint: She left for the city first.

k:宙.mnemonic: A ball thrown over the roof (宀) stops and floats there. Wherefore (由) does it not fall? Nobody knows. It simply hangs above the house. Mid-air (air, space, sky).

k:況.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵) your elder brother (兄) wades out and calls back how things stand: how deep it is, how bad it looks. Condition (situation).

k:講.mnemonic: A scholar in a hood (冂) speaks for a full hour, each point in careful measure (計), while the students below write down every word. Lecture (club, association).
k:講.hint: Hooded scholar talks for an hour.

k:略.mnemonic: Rather than trudge (夂) around every rice field (田) and name it, the mouth (口) just says 'the fields' and leaves out the rest. Abbreviation (omission, outline, shorten).

k:亀.mnemonic: A reptile seen from the side: a head poking out at the top, a domed shell marked in plates, and a little tail curling out behind. Tortoise (turtle).

k:縄.mnemonic: Dainty (細) strands of straw are twisted together, as slowly and patiently as a tortoise (亀) walks, until they make one thick cord. Straw rope (cord).

k:額.mnemonic: Each member (員) must trudge (夂) in under the roof (宀) of the hall and read the page (頁) of rules carved on the framed plaque above the door. Tablet (forehead, plaque, sum).
k:額.hint: Rules on a plaque over the door.

k:夢.mnemonic: In the evening (夕) you lie down under a mosquito net (罒), and behind your forehead (冖) a field of flowers (艹) appears that is not really there. Dream (vision, illusion).

k:審.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) of the court each side waits for its turn (番) to speak, while the judge listens to them one after the other. Hearing (judge, trial).

k:閉.mnemonic: A gate (門) fitted with a lock so clever that only a genius (才) could pick it. It stays shut. Closed (shut).

k:焼.mnemonic: Ten (十) loaves go into the fire (火) of the oven on a tray with little legs (儿), and they come out brown and crusty. Bake (burning).

k:康.mnemonic: You lie in the shade under the canopy (广) while a servant (隶) brings cool water. Nothing to do and nothing to worry about. Ease (peace, harmony, relax).

k:療.mnemonic: On the sickbed (疒), day (日) by day, the big (大) pain grows small (小) until at last it is gone. Heal (cure).
k:療.hint: Big pain shrinking day by day.

k:雑.mnemonic: Gather (集) nine (九) odd things from the bottom of a drawer: a button, a key, a coin, some string. Not one belongs with any other. Miscellaneous.
k:雑.hint: Odds and ends from a drawer.

k:密.mnemonic: They meet under a roof (宀) hidden high on the mountain (山), and invariably (必) the door is barred and the voices are kept low. Secrecy (density, minuteness, carefulness).

k:献.mnemonic: Each year a prize dog (犬) is led to the altar on the south (南) side of the shrine and presented as a gift to the gods. Offering (present, offer).
k:献.hint: Prize dog led to the altar.

k:似.mnemonic: A person (人) copies the leader (亻) in dress and in walk until the two look alike, and the style suits him well. Becoming (resemble, imitate, suitable).
k:似.hint: Dressing and walking like the leader.

k:冬.mnemonic: You trudge (夂) home with every drop (丶) under your feet frozen hard: the last and coldest season of the year. Winter.

k:弾.mnemonic: The simple (単) idea behind the bow (弓), a small thing flung fast at a target, shrunk down to a single lump of lead. Bullet (twang, flip, snap).
k:弾.hint: The bow's idea, shrunk to lead.

k:戻.mnemonic: The big (大) man walks out of the door (戸), remembers his hat, and comes straight back in again. Re- (return, revert, resume).
k:戻.hint: Out the door and back again.

k:頼.mnemonic: A member (員) pins a page (頁) of promises to the village tree (木), and everyone who reads it knows they can count on him. Trust (request, believe, faith).
k:頼.hint: Promises pinned to the village tree.

k:誌.mnemonic: What you say (言) with the intention (志) that it be kept: written down, dated and filed away on a shelf. Document (records).
k:誌.hint: Words written down to be kept.
